proposed_from.topic: Output-sensitive exact-once enumeration of distinct coefficient tuples for the component-aligned Gaussian LiMVAM calibration frontier. This is a new attempt at parent eid_limvam_calibration_frontier: replace its failed completed-path quotient and unavailable child oracle by accumulated immutable original-label regression rows. Build and prune the 2^p removed-set compatibility DAG, intern exact edge rows, merge identical fragments at each removed set, prove the live-fragment right congruence and projection-to-output bound, and emit Theta_G(O_G) once per numerical tuple with common union-support ancestry in O(poly(p,m) 2^p max{1,N_out}) ordered-exact-real time and space. Keep the parent's model-valid arbitrary-pairing scope and reuse its covariance-region inference only; do not claim unrestricted LiMVAM, polynomial-delay, off-model nonchordal preprocessing, or continuum-region enumeration. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: The presolver derived the immutable row formula b(A,r)=Sigma[r,A]Sigma[A,A]^-1, proved that after source-to-sink pruning equal fragments at fixed A have identical completion sets and unequal fragments are completion-disjoint, and charged each bucket to at most N_out sink tuples. Deterministic exact row interning and integer-fragment tries avoid a real-hash oracle. The nonzero p=3 witness has exactly orders 123,132,213 and one tuple; exact checks passed 28 further cases and 654 permutations, including 24 orders collapsing to one tuple. Checks addressed Schur-slope confusion, dead prefixes, late collisions, empty graphs/outputs, exact equality, singular boundaries, and the off-model nonchordal obstruction. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Fully verify the composition of arbitrary-graph q-path exactness with coordinate-noise positive-definite completion on maintained-model inputs; no model-specific algebraic lemma otherwise remains open informally. EARLY KILL TEST: Independently implement rational p<=4 exhaustive order comparison, requiring every merged prefix completion set and every bucket bound to match; any mismatch stops the run instead of reverting to order enumeration. STRONGEST-FORM DRAFT (unverified, gaps listed inside): <repo-root>/internal/presolve_drafts/eid_limvam_fragment_hashcons_enumeration.md.
proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest causal-output comparator, GuoPerkovic2021MinimalEffects, proves minimality for distinct graphical total-effect functionals, not equality of observed-covariance coefficient tuples. The closest graph enumerator, WienobstEtAl2023MECEnumeration, establishes AMO enumeration in Theorem 1; Theorem 4 gives exact-once \(O(n+m)\)-delay bucket-AMO enumeration; Corollary 1 covers MPDAGs; and Theorem 5 covers PDAG consistent extensions after \(O(n^3)\) initialization. These graph-distinct routines cannot exploit factorial-to-one numerical collisions. The closest general quotient result, WangEtAl2023EquivalenceClasses, Algorithmica 85 (2023), 3003--3023, doi:10.1007/s00453-023-01131-1, requires a local colored decomposable AND--OR representation that the parent LiMVAM proposal did not have. The exact delta is the model-specific proof that \(\beta(A,r)=\Sigma[r,A]\Sigma[A,A]^{-1}\) is a write-once original-label row, that equality of live fragments at fixed \(A\) is an if-and-only-if right congruence with disjoint unequal completion sets, and that every fragment bucket injects into the final distinct tuple set. Combined with arbitrary-view maintained-input completion exactness, this yields exact-once enumeration in \(O(\operatorname{poly}(p,m)2^p\max\{1,N_{\mathrm{out}}\})\) ordered exact-real time and space. An independent rational exhaustive check passed seven \(p\le4\) cases, including complete, empty, path, and nonchordal cycle pairing graphs, and verified every prefix-completion equivalence, disjointness claim, sink set, and bucket bound; this is feasibility evidence rather than proof.

seed_details.seed: Immutable-row exact-once enumeration of the LiMVAM coefficient frontier.
seed_details.anchor_locator: Introduction, Theorems 2--3, Algorithm 1, proof sketch on page 4, and Discussion
seed_details.opened_anchor_evidence: The anchor orients the first edge of a shortest possibly causal path, recursively partitions an MPDAG, and proves pairwise distinct identified effect functionals by constructing Markov-equivalent Gaussian DAGs with different intervention means. Its conclusion emphasizes removing structural duplicates before estimation.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: Replace shortest-path graphical orientation signatures by the immutable original-label regression row \(\beta(A,r)\), then prove fragment equality at a live removed set is a right congruence for numerical completions.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for LiMVAM coefficient-tuple enumeration, multi-view output-sensitive causal discovery, and Gaussian-DAG numerical quotient enumeration found no occupied target--method pair.
seed_details.referee_objection: Immediate from GuoPerkovic2021MinimalEffects because both algorithms recursively partition compatible structures by their causal output.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their partition is determined by graphical orientations and targets distinct functionals; numerical equality here depends on the observed covariance, can appear only after later removals, and requires an output-size bound for partial assignments.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The seed names the recovery map, exact-once property, right congruence, and total complexity; it does not claim unrestricted LiMVAM or polynomial delay.

seed_details.seed: Arbitrary-view q-path and coordinate-completion equivalence on maintained inputs.
seed_details.anchor_locator: Theorem on removed-set recursion, theorem on graph completion, and their separate proof boundaries in the banked write-up
seed_details.opened_anchor_evidence: The parent proves path-independent Schur states and separately characterizes fixed-order compatibility by observed residual diagonality plus coordinatewise positive-definite completion, but does not compose the two results for arbitrary view graphs inside a duplicate-free enumerator.
seed_details.changed_proof_step: Extract every candidate order's coordinate principal blocks from one generating full residual covariance and show that independently assembling those blocks reproduces all observed edge covariances.
seed_details.destination_search: GroneEtAl1984PositiveDefiniteCompletion occupies the chordal universal-completion theorem, while searches found no LiMVAM result composing arbitrary graph residual paths with value-specific noise completion.
seed_details.referee_objection: Immediate because a maintained-model input already has one positive-definite full covariance completion.
seed_details.rebuttal: The generating completion need not be component-aligned under a wrong candidate order; the proof must extract candidate-order coordinate blocks and verify that their independent reassembly preserves every specified residual and observed covariance entry.
seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The condition is not assumed as a completion oracle; both directions and the constructive certificate are formal theorem obligations.

seed_details.anti_pattern_check: The generic component is explicitly downgraded and is not marketed as the causal novelty.

seed_details.changed_proof_step: Clear the principal-regression denominators and classify equality of two orderwise coefficient tuples as an algebraic fiber, then bound the exceptional strata over the maintained parameter space.

seed_details.rebuttal: Some orders are identically equal through commuting roots, so one must first classify map identity versus exceptional equality; the classification, not merely nullity, is the hard object.

proposed_from.literature_map: Heurtebise et al. introduce LiMVAM, identify shared causal partial orders and coefficients by second-order diversity, prove recursive residual closure in Appendix D.3, and estimate coefficients by one-step feasible generalized least squares; the paper does not enumerate the numerical ambiguity left by partial pairing. Guo and Perkovi\'c, Theorems 2--3, recursively partition an MPDAG into subclasses with pairwise distinct total-effect functionals, furnishing the writing arc from repeated structural witnesses to minimal causal outputs. Wien\"obst et al., Algorithm 1, Lemma 3, and Theorems 1 and 5, use maximum-cardinality search and branch disjointness for linear-delay graph-distinct enumeration. Wang et al. enumerate locally colored equivalence classes in decomposable acyclic AND--OR graphs with polynomial delay, but their conclusion leaves nondecomposable quotient enumeration open. Deep, Hu, and Koutris, Theorem 6, use heavy-light partitioning and interleaving for output-dependent projected-query delay, confirming that projection can change the relevant output scale without supplying the LiMVAM congruence. Avis and Fukuda use locally searchable parent maps for memory-efficient reverse search. Conte et al. survey flashlight search, solution-graph traversal, push-out amortization, hardness, and approximation in output-sensitive graph enumeration; the fragment algorithm instead uses a model-specific right congruence and a direct projection charge. Grone et al., Theorem 7, give the chordal boundary for universal positive-definite completion; maintained LiMVAM inputs instead provide value-specific completions on arbitrary view graphs. Bareiss controls fraction-free elimination growth for one exact linear system, leaving aggregate row-key bit complexity open. Wang, Kolar, and Drton propagate causal-order confidence sets to ancestry and effects but do not quotient numerical coefficient collisions. Boege et al. provide adjacent algebraic Gaussian-DAG tools. Searches through September 7, 2026 found no closer paper that exact-once enumerates distinct LiMVAM coefficient tuples from a removed-set graph with total cost polynomial in \(2^p\) and \(N_{\mathrm{out}}\).

banked_reason: The pairing-informative result applies only to the component-aligned subclass and retains explicit 2^p subset-state dependence, so the sound two-layer theorem is subfield rather than field tier.
banked_proposal_promise_gap: A field-tier version would need a new faithful global cross-subset output-equivalence or canonical-representative method eliminating explicit 2^p preprocessing without assuming the quotient oracle; the zero-system suffix-language witness rules this out for the current deterministic removed-set automaton.
